name: codecalc
description: Code & logic calculator for AI agents: 31 languages, symbolic math, SMT/logic solving, Big-O.

runtime_path.title: Runtime PATH
runtime_path.description: PATH executed code resolves language runtimes on (CODECALC_RUNTIME_PATH). Claude Desktop launches the server with a stripped environment, so an inherited PATH can miss a toolchain manager's shims (mise, nvm, rustup, ...) entirely and most languages silently become unavailable. Leave blank to fall back to the server's own PATH.
